results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if verifying you’re in the right Brevo workspace/account)] [Prerequisite]: Fetch account context using BREVO_GET_ACCOUNT_INFO (confirm correct tenant before writing).

[Optional (if folderId or existing list ID unknown / avoiding duplicates)] [Prerequisite]: Enumerate current lists using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS (find target folderId and detect naming conflicts; paginate via limit/offset if needed).
[Required] [Step]: Create the segmentation list using BREVO_CREATE_CONTACT_LIST (confirm final list_name and target folderId if used; capture returned list id).
[Optional (if creation needs verification or a naming conflict is suspected)] [Fallback]: Re-check lists using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS (confirm the new list appears and record its id/folderId).
[Optional (if validating population/backfill)] [Next Step]: Retrieve contacts using BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS (review/export for downstream assignment; iterate pages for large datasets).
[Optional (if checking a single person’s status)] [Next Step]: Retrieve a contact using BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS (confirm a specific contact exists before targeting).
known_pitfalls: [BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS] Similar list names can exist—disambiguate by list ID/folderId, not name alone.
[BREVO_CREATE_CONTACT_LIST] Write operation—double-check list_name and folderId selection to avoid creating/segmenting in the wrong place.
[BREVO_GET_ALL_CONTACTS] Large contact databases require paging; don’t treat the first response as complete.
[BREVO_GET_CONTACT_DETAILS] Lookups depend on the exact identifier (e.g., email); trim/normalize input to avoid false negatives.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue) is an all-in-one email and SMS marketing platform that provides transactional messaging, marketing automation, contact management, and CRM tools to help businesses communicate and engage with their customers.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=brevo. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="brevo") to create a connection BEFORE executing any brevo tools.

BREVO_CREATE_CONTACT_LIST.description: Creates a new contact list (audience) in Brevo within a specified folder. Contact lists are used to organize and segment contacts for email campaigns, SMS campaigns, and marketing automation workflows. Use this tool when you need to: - Create a new audience segment for a marketing campaign - Organize contacts by specific criteria (e.g., geographic location, interests, purchase history) - Set up a list for newsletter subscribers, event attendees, or customer segments - Prepare a target audience before adding contacts or launching campaigns Note: You must specify a valid folder ID. Use Get Contact Lists to view existing folders and their IDs.

name.description: Name of the contact list to be created. Must be unique within the folder. Use descriptive names that indicate the list's purpose (e.g., 'Newsletter Subscribers', 'VIP Customers', 'Product Launch Campaign').

folderId.description: ID of the parent folder in which this list is to be created. Use the Get Contact Lists or Get Folders endpoint to retrieve valid folder IDs from your Brevo account. Folder IDs are integers (e.g., 1, 2, 3).

BREVO_GET_CONTACT_LISTS.description: Retrieves all contact lists from your Brevo account with pagination support. Returns list IDs, names, subscriber counts, and folder associations. Use this to discover available lists or obtain list IDs needed for other operations (e.g., SMS campaigns, adding contacts to lists).

sort.description: Sort order by creation date: 'asc' (oldest first) or 'desc' (newest first).

limit.description: Number of contact lists to return per page.

offset.description: Index of the first contact list to return (for pagination).

BREVO_GET_ACCOUNT_INFO.description: Retrieves comprehensive information about the authenticated Brevo account. Returns account details including: - Account holder information (email, first name, last name, company name) - Complete address (street, city, zip code, country) - Plan details with credit information (type, credits remaining, start/end dates) - Relay configuration for transactional emails (enabled status and data) - Marketing Automation status and tracker key (if enabled) No input parameters are required - the action uses the authenticated account's credentials. Use this action to: - Verify account configuration and settings - Check available credits and plan type - Monitor transactional email relay status - Retrieve Marketing Automation tracker information. If credentials are missing or invalid, verify the Brevo connection is active before calling — retries will not resolve credential issues. If blocked by an 'unrecognised IP address' error, add the integration host's IP to the Brevo account allowlist.
